en.title: Airside or landside?

items.text: Some countries still need a transit visa

en.focal: Check the country you connect through
en.alt: Diagram comparing airside transit, where you stay past security and do not pass immigration though some countries still need a transit visa, with landside transit, where you leave the secure zone, pass immigration and usually need a visa
en.caption: Airside stays in the terminal; landside means entering the country.
